def solution():
    # Define variables
    closing_prices = [102, 100, 105, 107, 103]
    trading_volumes = [1500, 1600, 1400, 1300, 1350]
    nvi = 1000.0

    # Calculate NVI for each day after the first
    for day in range(1, len(closing_prices)):
        if trading_volumes[day] < trading_volumes[day - 1]:
            price_change_ratio = (
                (closing_prices[day] - closing_prices[day - 1])
                / closing_prices[day - 1]
            )
            nvi += price_change_ratio * nvi

    # Return the NVI after five days, rounded to two decimal places
    return round(nvi, 2)
